project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Glitch OS desktop — a malfunctioning retro computer that renders repos into mascots: CRT-dark desktop with scanlines and dark grid wallpaper, stacked OS windows with title bars, terminal logs and instantaneous RGB chromatic-aberration glitch slices (body text never glitches; glitch stays on aria-hidden decoration layers).
